notes.subject: fix(tools): close triaged feedback on reviews, compose, telemetry and write_file
notes.summary: write_file accepts an optional expected_content_hash that refuses stale rewrites; incomplete background reviews no longer say "no issues"; compose recovery lists children in call order; telemetry context log streams.

notes.subject: feat(diagnostics): opt-in heap pressure profiler for extension host OOM crashes
notes.summary: Adds an opt-in agentlink.diagnostics.heapProfiling setting that writes heap profiles and top-allocator summaries as extension host heap use rises, to diagnose out-of-memory crashes.

notes.subject: fix(retrieval): stop chunk search text retaining whole source metadata (ext host OOM)
notes.summary: Fixes an extension host out-of-memory crash by stopping chunk search text from retaining whole source metadata.

notes.subject: fix(retrieval): cut session-history index memory and explain non-retryable background failures
notes.summary: Reduces session-history indexing memory use and delays the history backfill; get_background_result failure JSON now includes a recovery explanation when a run is not retryable.

notes.subject: fix(auto-continue): continue an already-completed turn when enabled
notes.summary: Auto Continue now continues an already-completed turn when enabled, pauses with a reason if the continue prompt cannot be sent, and editor panes show the current state.

notes.subject: fix(execute_command): recognise more commit workflows before sandbox launch
notes.summary: Protected Git preflight recognises more commit workflows (checksum guards, commit --only and -F, diff --diff-filter, log -n), so they offer reviewed native execution instead of failing in the sandbox.

notes.subject: fix(tools): background network review, failed-proposal buffers, large reads
notes.summary: Fixes network review for background commands, lets edits replace a leftover failed agent proposal in an editor buffer, and read_file now streams windows from text files above 32 MB.

notes.subject: feat(fleet): keep reviewer coverage notes in review_findings results
notes.summary: review_findings results accept an optional bounded checked list of coverage notes, which is requested from reviewers and shown under Checked in results and cards.

notes.subject: fix: send documents to OpenAI-compatible models instead of failing
notes.summary: Documents attached to chats on OpenAI-compatible models no longer fail: text documents are inlined, and PDFs are sent as file parts when the new supportsDocuments option is set, otherwise replaced by a note.
